a: MediTriage AI is a clinical decision-support platform designed for geriatric emergency triage. It evaluates symptoms against the patient's individual baseline, flags medication masking, and assists attending doctors in prioritizing care.

MediTriage AI provides decision support only, not medical diagnosis or prescription. Under India's DPDP Act principles, an authorized registered physician always evaluates the patient and makes the final triage decision.
If experiencing severe chest pain, stroke signs, difficulty breathing, or collapse, call National Emergency 112 or PMC 108 immediately. Do not wait for online intake or chat evaluation.

Triage intake is a guided 4-step wizard: grant digital informed consent, select your primary symptoms and severity, record home vitals if available, and list current medications. Results are computed instantly.

Triage assigns four levels: Red (Emergency — immediate life-threatening care), Yellow (Urgent — medical review within 1-2 hours), Blue (Routine — scheduled clinic consult), and Green (Self-Care — at-home symptomatic management).

The Confidence Badge indicates agreement between deterministic clinical safety rules and AI inferences. High confidence (●) indicates strong evidence alignment, while Medium (◐) or Low (○) prompts mandatory clinician review.
Medication Shield alerts clinicians when a patient's daily drugs (like beta-blockers or analgesics) mask physiological stress indicators like elevated heart rate or fever, preventing under-triage.

Older adults often have unique baseline vitals (e.g. chronic hypertension). The Geriatric Delta Engine compares reported vitals against their historical baseline rather than standard young-adult textbook ranges.
The Emergency QR Card contains an encrypted, time-limited summary of vital conditions, allergies, and blood group. Paramedics can scan it on an ambulance run without needing an account or login.
Yes. To protect patient privacy under DPDP Act 2023, public emergency QR cards automatically expire after 30 to 90 days. You can regenerate or revoke the card anytime from your manager.
Yes. Family caregivers can register, link to an elderly parent with consent, and submit proxy symptom assessments, update medication baselines, or manage emergency QR cards on their behalf.
MediTriage AI natively supports English, हिन्दी (Hindi), and मराठी (Marathi). Use the language switcher in the top navigation header to toggle your preferred language at any time.
Elder Mode enlarges typography to 20px base, expands tap targets to 56px, increases contrast to 7:1 (WCAG AAA), and disables rapid animations for senior users and low-vision individuals.

Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023, your data is processed strictly for triage care. You have the statutory right to view, correct, export, or permanently erase your health records.
You can withdraw your digital consent at any time via your patient settings or by contacting privacy compliance. Upon withdrawal, future processing ceases immediately.

You can upload a clear photo of a skin lesion or wound during case review. Our dual-agent pipeline analyzes morphological descriptors and severity. This is advisory: a doctor always inspects the lesion.
Augmented Reality (AR) and 3D camera features are currently unavailable. We use standard, high-resolution 2D photos with framing guides to ensure reliable performance on all mobile devices.
All triage cases are routed to the attending clinician queue. Priority is given to emergency and urgent flags. Cases remain marked 'Pending Review' until confirmed or amended by a licensed physician.

As an academic clinical prototype, certain specialized triage decision rules carry an 'Awaiting Clinical Review' tag to notify providers that ongoing peer review is underway before full production lock.

Yes. Once an Emergency QR Card is generated, it functions 100% offline. Cached local clinical guidelines also remain accessible even during network interruptions.

For patient and caregiver accounts, contact hospital intake support or use account recovery. Clinician and administrative accounts require security verification by your designated hospital administrator.

Clinician Copilot is an AI sidecar for verified doctors. It synthesizes complex geriatric histories, highlights medication interactions, drafts shift handoff digests, and proposes structured triage amendments.
The AI Hub offers four specialized services: Plain-Language Summary Explainer, Doctor Visit Preparation Checklist, Medication Interaction Review, and the Geriatric Health Companion chat assistant.

Chest pain, pressure, or pain radiating to the jaw/arm in older adults is an immediate medical emergency. Do not attempt home treatment. Call 112 or transport to the nearest emergency department right away.
Remember FAST: Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, Time to call 112. Acute stroke requires hospital thrombolysis or intervention within golden hours. Call 112 immediately.
Falls in older adults may cause hidden subdural hematomas, fractures, or internal bleeding—especially if on blood thinners like aspirin or warfarin. Seek clinical examination promptly.

Sudden onset confusion (over hours or days) is typically Delirium, often triggered by infections (UTI, pneumonia) or medications. This is an urgent medical condition requiring rapid doctor evaluation.
All clinical overrides, triage amendments, and data access events are cryptographically hashed and logged to an immutable audit trail adhering to DPDP Act 2023 compliance standards.

Break-glass protocol grants emergency physicians immediate elevated access to an incapacitated patient's complete history during life-threatening crises, creating an immutable high-priority audit record.

In Step 3 of intake, you can enter home blood pressure (e.g. 130/80), heart rate (bpm), oral temperature (°F), and oxygen saturation (SpO2 %). If you don't have these instruments, vitals are optional.

Older patients frequently do not exhibit typical symptoms. Serious infections may present as mild confusion or loss of appetite rather than high fever. MediTriage adjusts safety thresholds accordingly.
Yes. Look for the microphone icon in the intake form or chat composer. Tap it once to dictate symptoms in English, Hindi, or Marathi without typing.
On your Case Result page, click 'Download Clinical PDF' to generate a print-ready clinical report formatted with triage levels, vitals delta, and medication shield alerts to hand to your doctor.
The administrative control plane includes cryptographic kill switches allowing hospital administrators to instantly suspend AI models or fall back to deterministic-only rules within milliseconds.
Through the AI Hub Medication Review tool, seniors and caregivers can input their daily drug regimen to detect known polypharmacy conflicts, renal clearance warnings, or symptom masking.

q: how to prepare for doctor visit
a: Use the AI Hub 'Visit Prep' module to compile a tailored 1-page question sheet and symptom timeline to take to your upcoming consultation with your geriatrician or primary doctor.
Deleted cases enter a 30-day grace period where they remain restorable before permanent cryptographic erasure, preventing accidental loss of medical history.
